title: Bias coefficient and squared radius
statement: Let $p,\alpha,\beta\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $1<p<2$, $0<\alpha<\beta$, and $\alpha^p+\beta^p=1$. Then $\dfrac{\alpha^p\beta^{2-p}-\alpha^{2-p}\beta^p}{\alpha^2-\beta^2}=\rho\!\left(\dfrac{p}{p-1},\alpha^p\right)^2$, where $\rho(q,\lambda)=\sqrt{\sinh(u/q)/\sinh(u/(q/(q-1)))}$ and $u=\log((1-\lambda)/\lambda)$.
